subject: Arcadia vendor intake — owner names, PO cadence, security checklist
messages:
From: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@arcadiabiotech.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@arcadiabiotech.com>, procure@arcadiabiotech.com
Date: 2026-10-05T23:12:00Z
Subject: Follow-up from today's call — next steps on procurement

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for walking the team through the Redwood runtime today — Tom and I found the latency/cost breakdown especially helpful. A couple of things we need to lock down on our side so we can move to procurement:

- Confirm owners: who at Redwood will be the primary procurement contact (PO/invoicing) and who handles security evidence (SOC2, data residency)?
- Vendor intake packet: can you share a single PDF with the security checklist + standard SLAs?
- PO timing: our finance team needs a template and a typical lead time for PO issuance once SOW is signed.

Tom and I are trying to surface these to Finance and IT tomorrow afternoon; if you can send the packet and a short owner list, we can route it into our intake tool.

Best,
Sofia Delgado
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Arcadia Biotech

[attachment: arcadia_questions.txt (text)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@arcadiabiotech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@arcadiabiotech.com>, procure@arcadiabiotech.com
Date: 2026-10-06T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's call — next steps on procurement

Sofia — thanks for the clear asks. Quick recap and owners from our side: 

- Procurement / PO & Invoicing: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.ai) — handles PO templates, billing contact, and finance intake.
- Security & Compliance evidence: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai) — will provide SOC 2 artifacts, data residency notes, and the questionnaire responses.
- Technical onboarding lead (pilot coordination): Alex Martinez (me) — will run the pilot, provide model/throughput profiles, and coordinate pilot billing.

Attachments I'm sending now: Redwood vendor packet (includes SOC 2 summary, security checklist, sample SLA) and a blank PO template you can circulate to Finance.

Immediate next steps:
1) I'll upload the vendor packet to the HubSpot deal and send the DocuSign SOW template if you want a quick signature path.
2) Laura — can you confirm expected invoice cadence (net 30/45) and whether Arcadia requires W9/other tax docs?
3) Rishi — I'll copy you on any security intake forms Arcadia sends; please confirm turnaround on questionnaire completion.

If that works, Sofia, can you confirm who in Finance we should address the PO template to and whether they need the packet as a PDF or via your vendor portal?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

[attachments: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (pdf), arcadia_po_template.docx (docx)]

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@arcadiabiotech.com>

Cc: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@arcadiabiotech.com>, procure@arcadiabiotech.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-07T09:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's call — next steps on procurement

On 2026-10-06, Alex Martinez wrote:
> Attachments I'm sending now: Redwood vendor packet (includes SOC 2 summary, security checklist, sample SLA) and a blank PO template you can circulate to Finance.

Thanks Alex — received both files. A few clarifications from finance/procurement: 

- Finance contacts: Melissa Chan (AP Manager) <melissa.chan@arcadiabiotech.com> and the procurement inbox procure@arcadiabiotech.com. Please address the PO template to Melissa.
- Invoice cadence: Arcadia prefers Net 45 for new vendors; will need W9 and bank details for supplier setup.
- Security intake: IT has a short vendor questionnaire (7 items). If Rishi can turn around the answers in 48 hours, we can queue Redwood for their vendor onboarding this sprint.

Also — do you have a standard SOW amendment for pilots (2–4 week pilot, capped monthly spend)? If so, can you share it so we can include it in the vendor packet?

Tom
Procurement Lead
Arcadia Biotech

[Note: forwarded procurement inbox for visibility]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@arcadiabiotech.com>, Melissa Chan <melissa.chan@arcadiabiotech.com>
Cc: Sofia Delgado <s.delgado@arcadiabiotech.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, procure@arcadiabiotech.com
Date: 2026-10-08T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's call — next steps on procurement

Tom / Melissa — looping you both in and confirming next steps from Redwood's side.

1) PO template: attached a version prefilled with our billing remittance and Redwood's tax info — use that to open the supplier record.
2) W9 & bank details: Laura, could you share the W9 and bank remit to Melissa (cc'd) and confirm whether we should send as PDF or through their portal?
3) Security questionnaire: Rishi — Melissa flagged the 7-question vendor IT form; can we complete and return within 48 hours? If yes, I'll mark Arcadia for priority onboarding.
4) Pilot SOW: here's a short SOW template for a 3-week pilot with a spend cap and rollback clauses: https://www.docusign.com/link/example-signature-id. If Arcadia wants DocuSign, we can route that same doc.

Request to Arcadia: please confirm the PO lead (Melissa is ok) and the desired invoice terms. If Net 45 is the preference, Laura, please note and we'll set payment terms accordingly.

I'll follow up after Laura/Rishi confirm attachments. Thanks everyone — aiming to have vendor intake submitted by Monday so Finance can kick supplier set-up.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
